items.title: All your windows in one
items.text: Set `macos-window-mode = single` (Settings → Panes & Windows → Windows) and every window becomes a workspace inside one window. Click a window in the sidebar's all-windows list to switch to it in place — its layout, stashed panes and focus come back exactly as you left them, and the background fades to its color. Takes effect the next time Ghoztty starts.

items.title: Hidden workspaces rest
items.text: A workspace you are not looking at keeps running but stops drawing and gives back its graphics memory, and catches up the moment you switch to it.

items.title: Scripts see no difference
items.text: `ghoztty +list`, `--target`, `+split`, `+read`, `+send-keys`, `+stash` and `+close` treat each workspace as a window, and reach one you are not looking at without switching to it. `--focus` is what switches.

items.title: Sessions come back in either mode
items.text: Restored sessions return as workspaces in single-window mode and as windows otherwise, with the one you had in front back in front.

items.title: Cmd-Shift-Up/Down walks your windows
items.text: Outside hero mode, Cmd-Shift-Up and Cmd-Shift-Down go to the previous and next window in the sidebar's list. (They used to jump between shell prompts; `jump_to_prompt` can still be bound to another key.)

items.title: Snappier New Window
items.text: Cmd-N shows the new window right away instead of a beat later.

items.title: Close a window you just opened without a prompt
items.text: Cmd-N then Cmd-W no longer asks "are you sure?" — a shell you have not typed into yet closes straight away, even before its prompt appears.

items.title: New windows stay in order
items.text: Windows with the same name (every new shell is `~`) now stay in the order you opened them in the sidebar, so the selection no longer jumps around.

items.title: More room for the hero
items.text: Hero mode hides the pane sidebar while it is on, and works with a single pane too.

items.title: A slimmer carousel
items.text: The carousel now starts 130 points wide. Change it with the new `macos-hero-carousel-width`, or keep sizing it by share of the window with `macos-hero-carousel-ratio`.

items.title: Minimized blades stay minimized
items.text: A pane you minimized into a blade no longer pops back out when a page in it grabs focus, or when Ghoztty relaunches.

items.title: Live reload keeps your place
items.text: Saving an HTML file you are viewing re-renders it without throwing you back to the top of the page.
